entities.name: Gender Reveal Parties
entities.label: Movement
entities.summary: Blogger Jenna Karvunidis cut a cake with pink filling to reveal her baby's sex — and created a global phenomenon. Gender reveals escalated into fireworks, skydiving, and (in one case) a California wildfire. Karvunidis later regretted the trend as her daughter came out as non-binary.
